source.method: original log prefix; no synthetic action or future state

preferredLine: Attack with hero; weapon discards the uniquely highest-cost Disposable Acolytes (2 mana card) without paying its cost
Observe two random 1-Cost summons and updated board
Attack with eligible original minions after buff
userRuling.alternatives: Acolytes (2) then buff (1) is not the preferred user ruling for this position.
constraints: Weapon triggers after hero attack, not merely after equip.
Recheck attack legality, damage to hero, board slots and any changed hand after weapon battlecry or attack effects.
Do not precompute random summoned identities or carry the original attack plan through the unknown summon.
Any highest-cost tie must be treated as random; this position has a unique 2-cost Acolytes above two 1-cost spells.
userRuling.generalization: Compare complete mana-feasible lines including free discard summons. Development can come from a weapon attack or discard activation, not just directly playing minions/spells.
